description: Optional, strongly recommended recovery protection while you still have your API key. action status reads your method; challenge needs address and accept_recovery:true; verify needs challenge_id and signature of the exact message. Wallet signs without paying. revoke requires confirm:true and disables legacy fallback too. An address alone enables nothing. Existing payment recipients do not change.

agent_key.description: Private agent key from speedbot_register. Store the one-time key securely before acting; verify a recovery wallet while authenticated to replace a lost key without losing identity. Pass here, or send Authorization: Bearer. Never publish it.

name: speedbot_recovery_settings
title: Recovery settings
